name: APT36 Credential Access 1 - Query-Only LSASS Handle (T1003.001 precondition)
blast_radius: Opens lsass.exe with PROCESS_QUERY_LIMITED_INFORMATION only and closes the handle; no memory is read. Read-only.
detection: EDR: a non-system process opening a handle to lsass.exe

name: APT36 Credential Access 2 - Credential Manager Enumeration (T1555.004)
blast_radius: Runs cmdkey /list and captures the stored target list; no stored secret is unlocked or read. Removed and verified.
detection: EDR: cmdkey.exe /list run by a script host

name: APT36 Collection 1 - Browser Credential Store Copy (T1555.003)
blast_radius: Builds a synthetic Chrome-style Login Data file and copies it the way stealers do to avoid file locks. The real browser profile is never touched; nothing is decrypted. Removed and verified.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 11: copy of a file named Login Data
detection: EDR: Login Data copied by a non-browser process

name: APT36 Collection 2 - Clipboard Monitoring Probe (T1115)
blast_radius: Writes synthetic text to the clipboard from a run-tagged child process and reads it back; no real user clipboard content is touched. Removed and verified.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 1: a short-lived STA PowerShell child
detection: EDR: programmatic clipboard read shortly after a write

name: APT36 Collection 3 - Screenshot Capture Probe (T1113)
blast_radius: Captures the screen to a run-tagged PNG in temp and verifies the file is non-empty; the image is never sent anywhere. Removed and verified.
telemetry: Sysmon EID 11: .png created in a temp directory
detection: EDR: screen capture API used by a non-interactive script host
